summary: A white bolt of lightning explodes against Tank's chair and blasts him into the air. Cypher checks his gun, unable to believe he missed, and curses. Tank gets back to his feet and lunges, but Cypher fires again, shooting him square in the chest. Dozer cries out in protest.

what_changes.before: Seated in his chair, then on his feet and able to lunge at Cypher.
what_changes.after: Shot twice, including a blast 'square into his chest,' leaving him down.
what_changes.evidence: a white bolt of LIGHTNING EXPLODES against Tank's chair, blasting him into the air

what_changes.before: Having exposed a rifle in the prior scene and now firing at a crewmate.
what_changes.after: Confirmed as an attacker who shoots Tank twice, betraying the crew.
what_changes.evidence: Cypher FIRES again, square into his chest

what_changes.before: Offstage, unaware of what is happening on the main deck.
what_changes.after: Witnessing Tank being shot and reacting with horror.
what_changes.evidence: DOZER No! I see you! I see you!

event_hint.one_line: Cypher turns on the crew, shooting Tank on the main deck.

uncertain: Whether Tank survives the second shot.
Whether Dozer is physically present on the main deck or witnessing remotely.

minds.wants: To kill Tank before Tank can kill or stop him, and to end the confrontation decisively so his betrayal can proceed.
minds.feels: Frustration and disbelief that his first shot missed, sharpened into cold urgency. He is committing fully to murder now — there is no going back, and the shock of his own action is buried under the necessity of finishing it.
minds.shows: A curse ('Shit') at his own miss, then mechanical efficiency — he fires again without hesitation or visible emotion.
minds.basis: He 'checks the GUN, unable to believe he missed' and curses, then 'FIRES again, square into his chest' the instant Tank lunges. The miss rattles him, but his response is not panic — it is immediate, aimed, lethal correction.

believes_about.belief: That Tank is a manageable obstacle who can be put down with a gun, as he put down Apoc and Switch.
believes_about.wrong_because: Tank is far more resilient and physically dangerous than Cypher anticipated — he survives a lightning blast and a chest shot, and Cypher's underestimation of him is what will ultimately get Cypher killed.

believes_about.belief: That Dozer is not watching and that this betrayal is a private act he controls.
believes_about.wrong_because: Dozer is witnessing and crying out — Cypher does not know his audience has grown, and that his secrecy is already collapsing.

minds.wants: To stop Cypher — to reach him before Cypher can fire again and end the threat to the ship and to Dozer.
minds.feels: A survivor's ferocity. Blasted into the air and burned, he still gets to his feet and lunges; the will to protect overrides the damage done to his body.
minds.shows: Only physical action — rising and lunging. He gets no line; his intent is entirely in the lunge.
minds.basis: After being blasted by the lightning, 'Tank is on his feet, lunging' the moment Cypher is exposed — he moves to attack despite having just been nearly killed, showing he is fighting for the ship, not merely reacting.

believes_about.belief: That Cypher, a crewmate, has turned traitor and must be stopped by force.

minds.wants: To intervene, to stop what he is seeing — to save Tank, whom he is watching be murdered.
minds.feels: Horror and helpless anguish. He is a witness forced to watch a betrayal unfold and cannot reach it.
minds.shows: A single cry of protest — 'No!' — the only expression available to him from wherever he is.
minds.basis: His line 'No!' comes immediately after Tank is shot 'square into his chest,' a raw, involuntary reaction to witnessing the shooting. The uncertainty of his physical presence only sharpens the reading: whether remote or on deck, he is watching and cannot act.

believes_about.belief: That Cypher has betrayed them all — the 'No!' is the sound of that realization hitting him as he watches a crewmate gun down another.

connects_back: sc-135: Cypher exposing the rifle on the main deck — this scene is the rifle being used.
The betrayal established in the event shape (Cypher's deal, the killings of Apoc and Switch) — this is Cypher continuing his purge of the crew.
Tank being at his chair operating the exit program in sc-135 — he is caught seated and exposed when the lightning/attack comes.
sets_up: Tank's survival and charred state (ev-024) — his being shot here and surviving sets up his return to kill Cypher.
The completion of Cypher's betrayal and its immediate reversal — his apparent success here is what makes his imminent death at Tank's hands possible.
Dozer's confirmed death (ev-024) — his horrified witnessing here precedes and is consistent with his being found dead on the ship.
dramatic_function: This is the violent payoff of Cypher's betrayal: it converts his quiet treachery into open, physical carnage, raising the stakes to life-and-death and nearly eliminating a beloved crewmate so that his survival becomes a reversal the audience feels.
